items.title: ShowCAIS 2026 SER poster
items.summary: Presented privacy-preserving wearable ML work at ShowCAIS on Friday, March 27, 2026.
items.venue: USC Center for AI in Society, ShowCAIS 2026
body: "Privacy-Preserving and Sustainable Biomechanical Modeling: Overcoming Data Scarcity in Wearable Sensing" presents SVD Embedding Regression (SER) for data-scarce wearable biomechanics.
The work emphasizes lightweight, privacy-preserving modeling that stays useful when data are limited and deployment constraints matter.
This News section now serves as the public archive for future talks, posters, and research milestones.
